sections.instructions: Write your gospel presentation in Japanese. Use the 5 core points and Ben's theological outline below as reference.

items.topic:
Core points (Japanese):
1. 私たちはいい人じゃない。
2. 自分の力で、私は天国に行けない。
3. イエス様は神様。
4. イエス様は私たちのつみのために死にました。そして、よみがえりました。
5. このことを信じれば〇〇さんも救われます。

Reference — Ben's gospel outline (Three Ways of Sharing the Gospel):

• Creation — God created everything; humanity created in his image; perfect Adam and Eve.
• Fall — disobedience = sin; separation from God; sin = death; problems and strife in life.
• God's plan — Old Testament Israel; the law; sacrifices could not fully pay for sin.
• Jesus — fulfills the law; dies on the cross to pay for sins; righteousness exchange (our sin for his righteousness).
• Resurrection — Jesus rose again; trust in him = forgiven and restored relationship with God; eternal life through faith in Jesus alone.
